name: Marcia Bennett
biography: Marcia Bennett (born in Evansville, Indiana) is an American-born Canadian actress and acting instructor based in Toronto, with over 50 years of professional experience. She holds a BA in Drama from the University of Evansville and a Master's in Theatre from the University of Missouri. Her film credits include Adventures in Babysitting (1987), The Hurricane (1999), Mr. Magorium's Wonder Emporium (2007), and Trap (2024). On television she has appeared in Beauty and the Beast (CW, 2012–2016), Mrs. America (2020), Guillermo del Toro's Cabinet of Curiosities (2022), and The Last of Us (2023). She is also a voice actress (Mrs. Muskrat in Franklin) and an acting instructor in Toronto. Her exact date of birth is unconfirmed. No major awards are on record.
